subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this stay as distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery work, or be folded into the broader Telegram ambiguous-send and guarded-lane recovery track?
rationale: The source evidence supports a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the older related issue and open PR do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track remaining recovery work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and its replacement fix path.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate item for `chat.history` latency if maintainers want separate ownership.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest merged history around Telegram guarded-lane and buffered replay recovery, which is the central product boundary decision.
